title: The Vampire takes shape
changes: The Vampire is now modelled in 3D and turned into pixel art: real volume, light from the same side in every facing, and glints on metal.
The Nightcoat's long cape and coat skirts hang as cloth and stream behind you when you walk and run.
All Vampire armour, hats and boots were remade the same way. Weapons, shields and books look as before.
